0022600026.text: The Boston Celtics visit the Charlotte Hornets in an Emirates NBA Cup East Group C game, with Boston (6-2, on a one-game winning streak) sitting 3rd in the East and 1.5 games back in the Atlantic, though they are just 1-2 on the road. Charlotte (3-6, on a five-game losing streak) is 10th in the East and 2 games back in the Southeast. Boston is without Devin Carter (out, illness) and Payton Pritchard (day-to-day, eye abrasion, game-time decision), while Charlotte is missing Grant Williams and Kon Knueppel (both out, hamstring) and has Dennis Schroder (thigh) and Moussa Diabate (quadriceps) listed as day-to-day game-time decisions. The teams have not played each other yet this season, and Boston won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, including a 113-102 win in Boston on April 7, 2026.
